4. RESCIND – 4-HOUR PARKING, 9 AM TO 8 PM, MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY EXCEPT
AREA Q PERMITS
Fell Street, north side, from Divisadero Street to 78 feet west (Supervisor District 5) (Requires approval
by the SFMTA Board) Raynell Cooper, [staff email removed — see the order]



Currently, signage at this location is confusing as the meters are shown as being part of the RPP
regulation, when in actuality the meter regulation supersedes the RPP regulation. This confusion is
now heightened with the installation of Pay or Permit Parking several blocks away in Hayes Valley. This
will allow the sign shop to install directional signs pointing west from the end of the metered parking.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.

5. ESTABLISH - 4-HOUR TIME LIMIT, 8 AM TO 6 PM, MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY
Portola Drive, north side, from 138 feet east of Dorchester Way to Kensington Way (Supervisor
District 7) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Raynell Cooper, [staff email removed — see the order]

This proposal responds to a request from the Supervisor's office to discourage long-term vehicle
storage that may be interfering with bike lane safety. This stretch of Portola predominantly does not
face any homes or other private parcels.

Public Comments: Received emails in general support prior to public hearing, one of which also
indicated that the westernmost 138 feet of the block is currently regulated by Residential Permit
Parking.
Decision: Revised location to exclude the westernmost 138 feet of the block. Approved by the City
Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and implementation.
